title: SEC1: Preserve parse error location info (line/col) for structural errors
description:
Several parse error paths lose location information by hardcoding line:0, col:0:

- form.rs line 78–79: 'unexpected end of input in statement'
- form.rs line 167–170: 'unclosed [' in string list
- form.rs line 228–232: 'unclosed (' in test list
- And 5+ more

These errors occur during structural parsing (after lexer has already lost the original token positions). The question: is line:0, col:0 intentional because we can't recover location? Or an oversight?

Impact: LOW. Error messages are still useful, but less precise.

Acceptance criteria:
- Audit form.rs to determine if location info can be preserved
  - If yes, thread position through the parser
  - If no, document why and mark with explanatory comment
- Ensure at least one structural error test checks location info
